name: How much natural light is required in a converted garage?

mainEntity.name: How much natural light is required in a converted garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windows/glazing must provide at least 8% of floor area for daylight and 4% for ventilation; existing garage windows often need enlargement or addition.

description: Windows/glazing must provide at least 8% of floor area for daylight and 4% for ventilation; existing garage windows often need enlargement or addition.
